content.introduction: This week's earnings include Lululemon Athletica on Thursday, with Wall Street expecting a 41.9% YoY decline in earnings. Broadcom is also scheduled, with analysts forecasting a 91.7% YoY earnings increase.
body:
Lululemon Athletica (LULU) represents consumer discretionary stocks on the earnings calendar, with the athletic apparel retailer's fiscal second-quarter results due out after Thursday's close.

Wall Street is calling for LULU to report earnings of $1.80 per share (-41.9% YoY) on revenue of $2.5 billion, unchanged from the year-ago period.

Track all markets on TradingView [...] But Wall Street remains positive for a longer-term rebound. In addition to a consensus Strong Buy recommendation from the 49 analysts following Broadcom who are tracked by S&P Global Market Intelligence, their $525.97 average price target represents implied upside of more than 40% to current levels.

As for Broadcom's fiscal Q3 print, analysts expect earnings of $3.24 per share, up 91.7% year over year (YoY), on revenue of $29.4 billion (+84.9% YoY).

Track all markets on TradingView [...] "We recently downgraded LULU to Sell as we believe current headwinds will likely prove to be more structural than what is being underwritten by the Street," says Truist Securities analyst Joseph Civello. "While the current management team is confident in an inflection in full-priced sales in the second half, we believe that will likely prove ambitious due to momentum remaining limited."
